_comment: The midwimble network's parameters. scripts/join_testnet.py builds from
exactly these values and refuses to run unless the binary it produces
prints genesis_block below and carries the bond rules below, so every
joiner is provably on one chain.
The network opened as the testnet on its launch day and becomes mainnet
when its early phase ends, at early_bonds_until (Unix seconds,
2026-10-31 00:00 UTC). Blocks stamped before then take a bond of
early_min_bond units locked early_bond_lock_days more days; blocks from
then on take min_bond units locked bond_lock_days more days.
The values from network to seeds were filled in on launch day: run
set_launch_params.py with the day's anchors, then copy the values it
wrote (and the genesis block id `midwimble params` prints) in here and
